218
# The sim model decides whether an entry under a folder taken along on a first-link Discard arrived from another device, and each clause of that rule has its own test: the record that last placed the entry, the ancestor it came with, placements before the take, this device's own result that places the entry in the folder from outside it, its moves within the folder, an agreed place outside the folder, entries another device adds between the answer and the build, and edits that keep the parent. Each test fails when its clause is mutated away.
# The other tests pin batches, nested arrivals, re-entry and this device's moves confirmed after the answer, which earlier versions of the model got wrong.
